title: Companion Holdings and the Extension Fee on Crestline Credits
content:
The extension-fee cardmember rate on a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers looks at the customer's holdings of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes.

**The rule.** The extension-fee cardmember rate is 0.80 for a customer holding an active Crestline Companion Pass Semiannual or Crestline Companion Pass Annual. It is 0.90 for a customer holding no active companion pass but an active companion certificate issued as the co-branded card anniversary benefit, and 1 for every other customer.

## Questions on the rule

**Does a pass together with a card anniversary certificate give a lower rate?**
No. A customer with an active pass has the pass rate of 0.80, whether or not a certificate is also held.

**Does any active companion certificate give 0.90?**
Only a certificate issued as the co-branded card anniversary benefit, and only when no companion pass is active. A certificate issued on another ground gives 1 when no pass is held.

**Does an expired pass count?**
No. Only an active pass or an active certificate counts.

## Combinations

| Active companion pass (Semiannual or Annual) | Active card anniversary companion certificate | Cardmember rate |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.80 |
| yes | no | 0.80 |
| no | yes | 0.90 |
| no | no | 1 |
